My favourite Mac transcription tool, MacWhisper, has rolled out another major update today, adding real-time meeting transcription, significantly improved speaker identification accuracy, deeper Apple Intelligence integration, and an all-new transcription model. Here are the highlights of this update.

MacWhisper integrates deeply with Apple Intelligence

I have written many articles about how I rely on MacWhisper, especially in my podcast production workflow.

MacWhisper is one of the earliest AI transcription tools developed for the Mac platform. Since its launch in 2023 by independent developer Jordi Bruin, it has been continuously improved, steadily expanding support for new models, services and workflows.

These improvements include automatic meeting recording, speaker identification, folder watching, system-wide dictation, local and cloud AI models, as well as integrations with services like Notion, Zapier, Obsidian and n8n.

Today, MacWhisper has been upgraded to version 15.2, introducing improved speaker identification powered by NVIDIA's newly released Nemotron 3 speaker diarisation model.

This change also brings another key feature of this update: real-time meeting transcription.

This feature has been on MacWhisper's public roadmap for some time and has now finally been realised, allowing users to view real-time transcriptions during sessions, rewind, copy, or send live transcription content.

On the transcription model front, MacWhisper 15.2 has added Alibaba's QWEN3-ASR transcription model, supporting 22 languages, with deep integration into Apple Intelligence, Siri, Spotlight and Shortcuts on macOS 27.

Mac users (including those in the EU) can now search transcriptions system-wide, open transcriptions with Siri, send text to Shortcuts, and reference on-screen transcriptions when querying Siri or Apple Intelligence.

Finally, MacWhisper 15.2 adds master and sub-folder functionality for organising transcription files and meeting notes, with support for dragging existing transcription files into folders from the sidebar.
